text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Happy birthday!! Made sure to get ya a 
proper present too!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You're always saying you don't even have 
time to eat because of all your research, 
right? So I got you these oligo-whatever 
candies—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oho, oligosaccharide candy!! Splendid, 
Pokke-kun!! Sending oligosaccharides at a 
time like this!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, right now I happen to be conducting 
a comparative study on the effects that 
consuming luxury items, such as sweets, 
have on an Umamusume's psychological and 
physical data.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I need a massive amount of carbohydrates 
to make parfait-flavored supplements, but 
shopping is such a chore. If I break down 
this candy and use it—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Haaah? You... You're telling me you're 
using something someone gave you as a gift 
for an experiment?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah— now, now, don't get so worked up. With 
this, we can recreate that parfait flavor!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Oligosaccharides pair wonderfully with 
Western sweets—they're low-digestibility 
and regulate intestinal health, utter 
perfection. So come now, don't make such a 
scary face, and offer up that candy to 
me—"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"You mean candy turns into a parfait?! 
That's the abso-freakin'-lute best!! Hey, 
let me have some of that too!!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...I gotta say, your emotional state right 
now is a little concerning.
